headline: A 2001 executive order created the President's Council on Bioethics, a group to advise on ethical questions in medicine and science.
what_it_does: This order set up a new council called the President's Council on Bioethics. Based on its title, the council's role was to look at ethical questions raised by advances in medicine and biological science. No summary was provided, so details such as who served on the council and what powers it had are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: The President and White House staff
who_it_affects.how: They gained an advisory council focused on ethics in medicine and science.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed November 28, 2001; the provided material gives no separate start date.
